environment.description: Same Flask application packaged as a container image and deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/internal-api-gateway-role with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. The function URL endpoint responds with {"Message":"Forbidden"} and HTTP 403 to any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an authorized IAM principal. Note: the Lambda runtime does NOT have network egress restrictions and the XML parser configuration remains unchanged in the deployed code.

config.runtime: AWS Lambda with Python 3.11 container image, 512MB memory
config.note: No WAF, no input validation layer, no XML filtering - auth boundary only
